sourceType: Independent original practice questions based on publicly listed exam or MCQ topics; not verbatim UNISA paper questions
sourceLimitations: These are newly written MCQs based on themes in the linked public source, not exact original paper wording. Some source previews are incomplete. Use the Source link to view the original where available.

questions.text: An information system collects a customer's order, calculates the total and displays a receipt. Which sequence is correct?
questions.explanation:
The order enters as input, the total is calculated during processing and the receipt is output.

Student note: Feedback can help improve later processing; it is not the same as output.

questions.text: What system should a retailer use to track customer enquiries, preferences and service history?
questions.explanation:
Customer relationship management systems bring together customer interactions to improve sales and service.

Student note: CRM = customer relationship management.

questions.text: Which system helps employees access documented expertise and lessons learned within a business?
questions.explanation:
KMS stores and shares knowledge so staff can reuse experience and make better decisions.

Student note: A KMS manages knowledge; a TPS records everyday transactions.

questions.text: A company offers a better service at a lower price than its competitors. What can this provide?
questions.explanation:
Competitive advantage means performing better than competitors in ways customers value.

Student note: Lower cost, differentiation and faster response are common advantages.

questions.text: A manager coordinates information systems staff with business department requirements. What job is being performed?
questions.explanation:
IS managers connect technical systems and services with the needs and goals of the organisation.

Student note: An IS manager does not only write code.

questions.text: A repeatable set of actions used to complete a business task is called a ...
questions.explanation:
A business process is a set of related activities that produce a service or result.

Student note: Examples: order fulfilment, payroll and hiring.

questions.text: Which database key uniquely identifies each row in a table?
questions.explanation:
A primary key gives each row its own unique identifier and supports relationships between tables.

Student note: A foreign key refers to a key in another related table.

questions.text: A virtual organisation coordinates outside specialists through online systems. Which resource helps it work?
options: One fixed office location for all partners
questions.explanation:
Networks allow independent people and organisations to collaborate across locations.

Student note: Do not assume a virtual business has no physical goods.

questions.text: What is the correct purpose of a management information system (MIS)?
options: Provide routine summaries and reports for managers
Make every decision without human judgement
questions.correctAnswer: Provide routine summaries and reports for managers
questions.explanation:
An MIS commonly turns recorded data into useful scheduled reports for operational and middle managers.

Student note: MIS reports differ from TPS transaction recording.

questions.text: Which of the following is part of a company's IT infrastructure?
options: Servers, networks, storage and platform software
Only the colour of the office walls
questions.correctAnswer: Servers, networks, storage and platform software
questions.explanation:
Infrastructure is the shared foundation that supports the organisation's information systems.

Student note: Think hardware, networks, operating systems, services and storage.

questions.text: Which statement about databases is correct?
options: A database organises related data for controlled access
A database is always a printed book
A database stores only one character
Every database must contain exactly one table
questions.correctAnswer: A database organises related data for controlled access
questions.explanation:
Databases help manage related data, reduce unnecessary duplication and enable reliable retrieval.

Student note: Records are rows; fields are columns in a typical relational table.

questions.text: Which technology lets employees use software over the internet without maintaining the program on every local computer?
questions.explanation:
SaaS provides applications through a service provider, usually accessed via browser or application.

Student note: Cloud does not mean data is not stored somewhere; the provider operates the infrastructure.
